Hello, I'm a marine scientist, and today I want to talk about plastic straws.
Straws are a symbol, and symbols matter. But let's look at the numbers.
Plastic straws make up well under one percent of the plastic that enters the ocean each year.
Most ocean plastic comes from fishing gear and from rivers carrying mismanaged waste from land.
So banning plastic straws, on its own, will not clean up the oceans.
If we want cleaner oceans, we need better waste collection where rivers meet the sea, and rules for lost fishing nets.
Straw bans can still help people think about single use plastic. But they are not the solution.
